rationale: Revised plan corrects two critical parameter errors from the prior execution: (1) denial_rate denominator changed from 'all_claims' to 'adjudicated_claims' to exclude Pended claims and match the golden definition (Paid, Denied, Adjusted only), ensuring statistical discipline and accuracy; (2) monthly_trend date_column changed from 'adjudication_date' to 'service_date_from' to track when care began rather than when claims were processed, eliminating temporal lag artifacts. All other components remain unchanged as they executed successfully with no feedback findings.
changes_summary: Two parameter fixes: (1) denial_rate denominator 'all_claims' → 'adjudicated_claims' to correctly exclude Pended claims and match the golden standard (1286 denied / 12339 adjudicated = 10.42%); (2) monthly_trend date_column 'adjudication_date' → 'service_date_from' to track care delivery timing rather than processing lag.
